name: Multi-Timeframe Confirmation
market_conditions: all three primary timeframes (1D, 4H, 1H) showing alignment in same direction
clear trend or directional bias visible on the daily timeframe
intraday timeframe (15M) providing a clean trigger entry
market not in high-uncertainty environment such as major news events
phase_requirements: markup phase aligned across 1D, 4H, and 1H for longs
markdown phase aligned across 1D, 4H, and 1H for shorts
15M in a pullback or setup phase within the aligned direction
entry_conditions: 1D timeframe: price above key moving averages (50 EMA and 200 EMA) for longs; below for shorts
1D timeframe: trend structure of higher highs and higher lows intact for longs; lower highs and lower lows for shorts
4H timeframe: EMA alignment bullish (EMA20 > EMA50) for longs or bearish for shorts
4H timeframe: price pulling back to a key level within the bullish/bearish structure
1H timeframe: showing reversal candle or entry signal aligned with higher timeframe bias
15M timeframe: trigger candle or pattern providing precise entry point
all four timeframes must show no conflicting directional signals
confirmation_requirements: 1D: bullish or bearish structure confirmed with no recent structure break
4H: EMA alignment in direction of trade confirmed
1H: reversal candle or momentum candle in direction of trade confirmed
15M: entry trigger candle confirmed — a breakout, reversal candle, or EMA cross
volume on the 15M trigger candle above the 10-period average
RSI on 1H above 50 for longs or below 50 for shorts
no divergence on the 4H or 1H timeframe that would contradict the trade direction
stop_loss_logic: Base stop loss on the 1H timeframe structure — below the most recent higher low for longs or above the most recent lower high for shorts. The stop must respect the 4H structure as well. Use ATR from the 1H timeframe for buffer calculation. Minimum stop distance equals 1 ATR on the 1H.
take_profit_logic: Primary target based on the 4H timeframe key resistance for longs or key support for shorts. Secondary target based on the 1D timeframe prior swing high for longs or swing low for shorts. Scale out 50% at the 4H target and trail the remaining 50% on the 1H EMA20 until the daily target or structure break.
invalidation_conditions: any one of the three primary timeframes (1D, 4H, 1H) shows a conflicting directional signal
daily structure breaks — a higher low is violated for longs or a lower high is violated for shorts
4H EMA alignment reverses or becomes neutral
15M trigger fails to follow through within 3 candles
RSI divergence appears on the 4H timeframe against the trade direction
broader market index diverges from the individual instrument direction on daily timeframe

required_features.4h_ema_alignment: EMA20 > EMA50 for longs or EMA20 < EMA50 for shorts
required_features.1h_signal: reversal or continuation candle aligned with higher TF

timeframe_requirements.macro: 1D for primary trend and structure; 4H for intermediate bias and key levels
timeframe_requirements.entry: 1H for confirmation signal; 15M for precise entry trigger

risk_notes: This strategy has the highest probability of success due to multi-timeframe alignment but requires patience — valid setups are less frequent. Do not force the setup by ignoring one timeframe's signal. All four timeframes must be checked systematically before every entry. The strength of this strategy comes from confluence — never compromise on alignment. Risk can be slightly higher per trade (up to 2%) due to the high-probability nature when fully aligned.
typical_rr: 1:2 to 1:5 due to high-confidence entries and larger move targets on higher timeframe alignment

agent_rules.rule: All three primary timeframes (1D, 4H, 1H) must be aligned in the same direction — one conflicting timeframe disqualifies the setup entirely.
Begin the analysis top-down: 1D first, then 4H, then 1H, then 15M. Never start from 15M and work up.
If the daily timeframe structure breaks after entry, exit the trade regardless of 4H or 1H signals.
The 15M trigger is the entry tool only — never use 15M alone to determine trade direction or bias.
Document which specific signal is present on each timeframe before entering — if any timeframe lacks a clear signal, wait.
Scale out 50% at the 4H target level — do not hold full position size into daily targets without moving stop to breakeven first.
Re-evaluate timeframe alignment on each new daily candle close — overnight events can invalidate the daily bias.
